product.name: NexaFlair Men's Regular Fit Solid Shirt
product.description: A men's regular-fit solid button-down shirt with long sleeves, a spread collar and standard length. The listing markets it as a linen-cotton shirt and positions it for casual and business-casual wear.

material.ai_display_rule: Do not make an unqualified linen/cotton claim.

variants.variant_status: Exact variant-level stock is not available.

review_summary.summary: Customers generally like the shirt's appearance and some report good fit, smooth fabric and good color. However, fabric quality, sizing, stitching and description accuracy receive substantial criticism. Multiple reviews question whether the shirt is actually linen and some report polyester-like material, thin or transparent fabric, collar stitching failure and fit problems.

buying_advice.size_advice: Do not blindly recommend the listed regular fit. Reviews report both shoulder tightness and slim-fit-like sizing. The user should check the size chart before ordering.
buying_advice.fabric_advice: Treat the linen-cotton claim as disputed. The listing identifies it as linen cotton, but verified customer feedback includes a direct polyester complaint.
buying_advice.quality_advice: Do not market this as premium quality. The 3.1/5 rating and review feedback indicate substantial quality concerns.
buying_advice.value_assessment: The captured price is ₹465 against an MRP of ₹999, making price the main reason to consider the product.
buying_advice.description_advice: Do not promise that the delivered shirt will have the exact textured appearance shown in product imagery because customers have reported receiving a plain-looking shirt.

source_inconsistencies: Listing identifies the product as linen cotton, while a verified customer explicitly reports polyester material.
The listing calls it regular fit, while a verified reviewer reports that the fit felt like slim fit.
Customers report that the delivered product may not match the textured appearance shown in the listing.

shopi_ai_rules.primary_rule: Recommend this primarily as a budget solid men's button-down shirt, not as a premium linen shirt.
shopi_ai_rules.material_rule: Never state '100% linen', 'pure linen', or 'premium linen'. The material claim is disputed.
shopi_ai_rules.quality_rule: Do not describe the product as premium or highly durable.
shopi_ai_rules.fit_rule: Use Regular Fit as the catalog attribute but warn users to check the size chart because reviews report inconsistent fit and shoulder tightness.
shopi_ai_rules.price_rule: Use affordability/value as a major selling point.
shopi_ai_rules.stitching_rule: Do not claim strong stitching or high durability because multiple reviews criticize stitching quality.
shopi_ai_rules.summer_rule: Do not automatically recommend it as a premium summer linen shirt. The actual material is disputed and fabric quality feedback is mixed.
shopi_ai_rules.description_rule: Do not promise that the physical shirt will exactly match the listing's textured appearance.
shopi_ai_rules.comparison_rule: When comparing with SHIRT-005, prefer SHIRT-006 only when the user prioritizes a lower price, solid design and color variety; prefer SHIRT-005 for stronger review sentiment and more reliable quality signals.
